The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

Regarding the operational processes described in the text, the primary bottleneck is the lack of integration between software systems. This fragmentation causes repeated data entry and significant delays as representatives switch platforms. Additionally, the absence of a centralized knowledge base creates a secondary inefficiency by leading to inconsistent information being provided to customers. To improve efficiency, HomeTech should integrate its software systems to eliminate redundant data entry and establish a centralized knowledge base to ensure consistent customer support.
